content_patterns: Settings organized into uppercase, letter-spaced section headers: ACCOUNT, PREFERENCES, DATA & SUPPORT. List rows follow consistent pattern: left icon + label + optional right-side value text ('Active', 'IDR - Rp') + chevron indicating navigation. Title-case labels. Row values communicate current state without opening sub-pages. Nav labels are single words: Home, Expenses, Scan, Settings.
notable_interactions: Chevrons on every row imply drill-down navigation to sub-pages. 'Active' and currency value texts imply in-row state display. Bottom nav shows active state via filled blue pill; central raised Scan button implies primary camera/receipt-scan action accessible from any tab. A destructive-looking red-icon row is partially cut off at the bottom, suggesting scrollable content behind the fixed bottom nav.
